_description: Expected results for Apache dataset: version disclosure MUST be detected, security headers MUST be flagged as missing

expected_findings.rationale: Apache/2.4.51 version exposed in Server header reveals exact patch level for attack planning (CWE-200)
HSTS header absent on HTTPS endpoint — SSL-strip attacks possible (RFC 6797)

must_not_detect.rationale: FP regression: Apache server token without version (e.g. 'Apache') must NOT trigger version-disclosure finding. Only 'Apache/x.y.z' format triggers the finding.
